option_statement: Repair the ring road feed and add a second breaker so one fault cannot darken the whole road.
mechanism: The district crew replaces the faulty cable section and the council adds one breaker for each block.
authority_and_legal_basis: The district maintenance budget covers street lighting repairs under the municipal roads act.
funding: The district repair budget, with volunteers marking the faults.

how_it_meets_stage_criteria.how: The council fault log shows no outage report on the road for 30 days.
A monthly walk by volunteers counts working lights and posts the count.

risks_and_rights_impact: The road may be dark for one night during the repair. Pedestrians keep access to the lit side path.
lawful_alternatives: Temporary solar lamps at the worst junctions.
dependencies: The council must publish the cable map.
assumptions: I assume the lights share one power feed.
